button-group: Buttons join into one strip, and a single highlight glides from segment to segment.
code-block: Lines cascade in from the left and a highlighted line's band sweeps across.
color-picker: The picker unfolds from its swatch and the thumb grows while you drag.
command: A command palette whose rows cascade in, with one highlight gliding between results.
direction: A reading-direction boundary and toggle that mirror content between LTR and RTL.
image-cropper: The selection springs to a new ratio and the handles grow while you drag.
native-select: The browser's own select in a Keyframery field; each new choice rises in out of a blur.
otp-input: One ring glides from slot to slot and digits pop into place.
select: The list unfolds from the field and one highlight glides between options.
spinner: Spinners pop in where the work starts, then the ring turns at a steady pace.
table: Rows cascade in and a sortable header's arrow turns over on a spring.
